Fixes #35.

## Summary
- Identifies Wikimedia API requests from formalization and target-label lookup to avoid live 429 failures.
- Rejects grammar-fragment n-grams such as `Hawaii is a`, `a state`, and `is a state` while preserving semantic phrase links.
- Demotes disambiguation-style candidates and renders the U.S.-state predicate as `штат`, producing `Гавайи это штат.`.
- Adds a deterministic issue #35 regression suite, round-trip coverage, changeset, and case-study research under `docs/case-studies/issue-35/`.

## Reproduction And Evidence
- Before captures are stored in `docs/case-studies/issue-35/data/live-translate-before.md` and `.json`.
- After live CLI capture: `docs/case-studies/issue-35/data/live-translate-after.md` renders `[Гавайи](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%B8 "Q782") это [штат](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A8%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%82_%D0%A1%D0%A8%D0%90 "Q35657").`
- Case study: `docs/case-studies/issue-35/README.md`.

## Testing
- `node --test tests/issue-16.test.js tests/issue-21-context-detection.test.js tests/issue-35.test.js`
- `npm test`
- `npm run check`
- `bun test`
- `deno test --allow-read`
- `bash scripts/check-mjs-syntax.sh`
- `bash scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh`
- `npx --yes -p secretlint -p @secretlint/secretlint-rule-preset-recommend secretlint "**/*"`
- `GITHUB_BASE_REF=main node scripts/validate-changeset.mjs`
- `GITHUB_HEAD_REF=issue-35-c9dc0853f1a0 GITHUB_BASE_REF=main node scripts/check-version.mjs`
- `git diff --check`
